reason: 1431 existing evidence locates a descriptor-epoch wait but does not distinguish mismatched layout, missing publication, visibility or transient process contention. Repeating the same failed command would leave these gaps unchanged.
preserve: Pinned original P0/P1 sources and libraries; no changes to timeout, ready, quiet, barrier or reuse semantics.
Fixed accuracy thresholds; a failed stage invalidates timing and dependent-stage launch.
Existing600-second owned-process watchdog and exact-PID cleanup. No foreign process intervention.
Training/performance qualification remains separate from diagnostic instrumentation.

required_host_evidence_before_any_future.consistency: Compare global layout/shape/config fields across all16 ranks through existing host coordination. Expected local rows may differ; ordinary GM output pointers and symmetric virtual bases need not be numerically identical. Never compare pointers as a substitute for translated remote mapping.
required_host_evidence_before_any_future.identity: Hash actual mapped kernel, _C, SHMEM and CATLASS/P1 libraries using live file descriptors and retain dev/inode/path. Save identities before and after the diagnostic sequence.
required_host_evidence_before_any_future.logger: Append compact line records before and after native calls with unique session/call labels. Record the native return separately from device completion. Do not introduce implicit synchronize or touch tensor values through .cpu()/item() merely to log metadata.
required_host_evidence_before_any_future.address_mapping_boundary: peer_address publishing uses pinned SHMEM SIMT direct heap-base translation, not the payload UDMA CQ path. Host workspace_base/offset alone cannot verify the device state heap_base or per-peer p2p_device_heap_base. Capture those values and translated descriptor addresses in a separately reviewed opt-in device snapshot if host evidence is insufficient.

ownership_sampling.scope: One separate read-only controller per host; no NPU context initialization.
ownership_sampling.boundary: Periodic samples can establish observed overlap, not exclude sub-sample transient contention. Existing process ledger and initial/terminal snapshots remain mandatory.

log_collection: Prioritize exact-PID run/plog and run/device original files before verbose DEBUG under a separate bounded budget.
Persist compact launch/phase records independently of rotating DEBUG logs. Rotation races must be recorded as collection gaps, not test root causes.
Retain original artifacts, per-file hashes and skipped-file manifests; do not overwrite previous runs.

existing_profile_hook_limit.finding: _dispatch_diagnostics enables kernel_timing and DevicePhaseTiming::finish synchronizes the communication stream. It also selects a profiling kernel. Enabling it is not a host-log-only change and could alter failure timing.
existing_profile_hook_limit.decision: Do not silently use that hook as an otherwise unchanged reproduction or as formal performance evidence. Any use requires separately recorded diagnostic scope.

device_snapshot_followup: Only if host metadata/ownership evidence leaves publication unresolved: design an isolated opt-in snapshot buffer recording descriptor address, four words, epoch and publication/wait stage with exclusive per-core writers. Preserve all completion and reuse semantics and audit perturbation. This is not implemented or authorized to launch here.
restart_policy: No automatic NPU launch from this plan. Primary review must identify a specific discriminating diagnostic or evidence-supported correction, verify CPU checks and fresh both-host ownership, and explicitly scope one bounded validation; failure stops again. No unchanged-command retries.

offline_host_recorder.status: Offline CPU preparation reviewed; not integrated, deployed or NPU-qualified
offline_host_recorder.parent_review: Corrected optional plan handling against actual peer_table ABI; native error now latches failed and prevents subsequent calls even if caught. No added tensor value reads/synchronization or changed native arguments.
offline_host_recorder.remaining: Explicit Notify host summary retention and phase-label integration, actual library identity, ownership sampling and device mapping evidence remain separate unfinished work.

initialization_log_update: outputs/p1_1431_initialization_log_review/summary.json narrows missing host initialization evidence; it does not observe actual device context/table bytes. No device launch authorization.
